transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for making time for this pre-filing review. As you know, we're planning to file the state application next month to expand our telehealth services, and I need to give final approval on the application and its accompanying operating conditions before we submit. The current draft describes the applicant as providing telehealth services through our existing corporate structure. Before I sign off, I need each of you — healthcare regulatory, corporate, insurance, and business — to review the package and flag any required changes. Let's start with healthcare regulatory. Are there any issues with how the application characterizes our telehealth services or the operating conditions as currently drafted?

Neither of those conditions is currently reflected in the filing package, so they'll need to be added before we submit.

The application and operating conditions will need to be revised to reflect the narrower pediatric behavioral-health scope before we submit.
